landing.heroText: Record your daily business income, expenses and savings — and understand your recorded cash flow with a simple tool built for small traders with limited digital skills.
landing.previewNote: A quick look at your recorded cash flow.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to stay on top of your money
landing.featuresSubtitle: Simple, fast and focused on what small traders actually need.
landing.f1Text: Add each sale and cost in seconds, with the date, category and payment method.
landing.f2Text: Set simple goals and watch your savings grow over time.
landing.f3Text: See your daily and monthly cash flow in easy-to-read charts.
landing.f4Text: Behave well on any device — designed for small screens first.
landing.f5Text: Your data is protected with a secure login and stays yours.
landing.f6Text: Export a summary as CSV or PDF to review or share with others.
landing.ctaText: It only takes a minute to create your account. Your records stay private and belong to you.

authLayout.pitch: A simple cash-flow and record-keeping tool for small traders in Rwanda. Record your daily income, expenses and savings — and understand your business at a glance.
authLayout.bullet1: Record income and expenses in seconds
authLayout.bullet3: See clear summaries and export reports

dashboard.subtitle: Your recorded business performance.
dashboard.noteStrong: Net cash flow = total recorded income − total recorded expenses.
dashboard.noteRest: This is calculated only from the transactions you enter into BIKA WUNGUKE, for the selected period. Savings are shown separately and are not counted as expenses, so the same money is never counted twice.
dashboard.noRecordsDesc: Add income and expense records to see your cash-flow chart.
dashboard.noSavingsDesc: Start putting a little aside and track it toward a goal.
dashboard.noTransactionsDesc: Your latest records will appear here.
dashboard.gettingStartedDesc: You have no records in this period. Add your first sale or cost to begin tracking your business.

transactions.title: Income & Expenses
transactions.subtitle: Every record you keep, in one simple list.
transactions.emptyDesc: Try changing your filters, or add your first record.

savings.title: Savings
savings.subtitle: Set money aside and keep track of your goals.
savings.infoText: Savings records the money <1>you set aside</1>. It is a note of what you have put aside — BIKA WUNGUKE does <1>not</1> verify money actually held in a bank, SACCO or mobile wallet. Saving records are kept separate from your business income and expenses, so they never inflate your recorded income.
savings.noGoalsDesc: Create a goal with a target amount to track your progress.
savings.remainingUnknown: Target must be a positive amount to calculate remaining.
savings.emptyDesc: Start putting a little aside each day and watch it grow.
savings.deleteGoalDesc: The goal will be removed. Contributions already recorded will stay but will no longer be linked to it.

savingsModal.disclaimer: Savings are money you set aside. Saving records are separate from your income and expenses, so they do not change your business totals.

goalModal.targetDateHint: When you would like to reach this goal.
goalModal.amountInvalid: Enter a target amount greater than 0

summaries.title: Financial summaries
summaries.subtitle: Weekly and monthly summaries built only from your own recorded transactions.
summaries.noRecordsDesc: You have not entered any transactions for {{label}}. Totals below are zero.
summaries.infoText: These figures are calculated only from the {{count}} transaction(s) you saved in this period. BIKA WUNGUKE never invents financial numbers or demonstration data.
summaries.pctNote: Percentage change is only shown when the previous period had data. Previous period {{income}} income / {{expense}} expense record(s).
summaries.noTrendDesc: Add records in this period to see your trend.
summaries.noExpensesDesc: No expense records in this period.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Review a summary of your records and export it to share.
reports.emptyDesc: Change the date range or add some records first.

financialRecord.title: My Financial Record
financialRecord.subtitle: A clear statement of what you have recorded in BIKA WUNGUKE.
financialRecord.disclaimerText: This report summarises information <1>you entered yourself</1>. It is not an official financial statement, a verified income certificate, a credit score, or a guarantee of loan approval. Nothing is sent to a bank, SACCO, lender, or anyone else unless you choose to share it.
financialRecord.noRecordsDesc: No transactions were saved for {{label}}. Change the period or add records.
financialRecord.previewIncludes: Includes {{count}} transaction(s) and category breakdowns. This preview shows exactly what the PDF will contain.
financialRecord.previewReminder: Reminder: this summarises your own entered records. It is not an official financial statement or income certificate.
financialRecord.shareWarningRest: Your financial record will only be shared when you confirm below. It is never sent automatically to a bank, SACCO, lender, or anyone else.
financialRecord.shareClipboardNote: If your browser does not support sharing, a copy of this summary will be placed on your clipboard instead.
financialRecord.shareLineNote: This summary was produced by BIKA WUNGUKE from records I entered myself. It is not an official financial statement or income certificate.
financialRecord.notSupported: Sharing is not supported in this browser. Download the PDF instead.
